messages:
Leila (CS): Heads-up: small set of EU onboarding flows returned 401s starting ~03:50 UTC. I exported impacted list (9 trials, 2 enterprise). Putting notes here to coordinate customer comms and remedial offers.
Rahul (eng-oncall): Investigating. Provider rotated client secret; eu-cluster missed the update. Kicked off secret resync. ETA ~20m.
Tom (Product): Flag BrightEdge (enterprise, renewal in 3 wks) on the list — CS please prioritize.
Vera (CS Ops): Recommend immediate customer note + offer of 1:1 session for enterprise + 14d credit for trials. I can schedule.
Maya (Legal): OK on credits. Wording: use "we apologize for the inconvenience" and avoid SLA language.
deploy-bot: secret-resync: started (job 2026-04-20-0355)
Rahul (eng-oncall): Resync finished 04:10 UTC; error rate back to baseline. Root cause: missing key-rotation webhook for eu region. Fix planned: webhook + alert + regional smoke test.
Leila (CS): Drafting short status to send at 04:30 UTC: acknowledge the interruption, note restoration time, include quick steps (fresh sign-in + x-rw-trace + timestamp), and offer credits/1:1. Posting for Legal check.
Maya (Legal): Approved with phrasing tweak (use "service was restored for affected users as of 04:10 UTC").
Vera (CS Ops): Sending personalized notes to BrightEdge now and booking 1:1. I'll log any renewal signals in the tracker.
Leila (CS): Sent at 04:32 UTC. Will update this thread with any replies that look like renewal risk or escalation.
